decisions.cost_rule: A miss costs more than a false action: a real defect ranked low is buried, while a false positive ranked high only costs a maintainer's glance. Fewer than about 30 labelled cases per label means the skill's provisional 0.3 for a costlier miss (building-eval-data), tuned on nothing.
assumptions: Minimums are the skill's default 0.8 precision and 0.8 recall (threshold-tuning), recall raised to 0.9 because a miss costs more; the user declined to set per-decision minimums on 2026-10-23.
Launch uses P(real_defect) only to order findings, so nothing reads the threshold: gating is false, the finding is never closed, hidden or filtered by it.
No labelled cases exist: the label set is none, the threshold is untuned, and the status stays provisional until labels set per-decision minimums and a tuning run reports ready.

Replacing this entry needs at least 30 human, outcome or agent_reviewed labels per label (real_defect and false_positive), stratified by path role and rule and split dev/test by repository, labelled blind from the frozen label guide, then a tuning run on saved scores with `--beta 2`. Agent labels come from two independent sessions that never see Jev's answer. The backlog item is B-2 in docs/jev-adapter-audit.md.

This entry has no pinned version key: it is bound to the question's current version key when loaded. A file at .scout/decisions/thresholds.json pins one; a key that no longer matches the current version marks the entry stale.
